newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela calls for OPEC production roll-over.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela calls for OPEC production roll-over.

text.p: Venezuela's Energy and Mines Minister Erwin Arrieta said Thursday OPEC's production ceiling should be kept at its current level at the next meeting scheduled for June.

"In view of the market's characteristics at this time and at this level of price it would appear that the most appropriate decision would be maintain the production ceiling, do a roll-over," Arrieta told reporters in Congress.

Arrieta added the caveat that a decision to roll-over OPEC's self-imposed but long-ignored 25.033 million barrels per day (bpd) output ceiling could be affected by any "new factors" which occur in the next few weeks.
Analysts and industry sources say Venezuela is one of OPEC's worst quota violators producing about 700,000 bpd above its 2.359 million bpd quota.
Arrieta's call for a roll-over echoed comments by other OPEC oil ministers who met last week for a sub-committee meeting in Iran.
